entrees.description_source: Turn a workflow you repeat into a plugin you can use again in ChatGPT. Describe the task in a conversation, add the instructions and reference material it needs, then test and refine the result.

en.texte: Turn a workflow you repeat into a plugin you can use again in ChatGPT. Describe the task in a conversation, add the instructions and reference material it needs, then test and refine the result.

fr.texte: Transformer un flux de travail répété en plugin réutilisable dans ChatGPT. Décrire la tâche dans une conversation, ajouter les instructions et la documentation de référence nécessaires, puis tester et affiner le résultat.

entrees.usage: Create a plugin called Document Summary. Summarize documents I provide in three sections: Overview, Key points, and Open questions. Use the attached template for the format. Base the summary only on the document. If requested information is missing, mark it as not provided. Do not edit the source document.

entrees.description_source: Plugins bundle capabilities into reusable workflows in ChatGPT and Codex. They can include skills and MCP servers. Both products use one universal plugin directory, so the same public plugins are discoverable from their supported surfaces.

en.texte: Plugins bundle capabilities into reusable workflows in ChatGPT and Codex. They can include skills and MCP servers. Both products use one universal plugin directory, so the same public plugins are discoverable from their supported surfaces.

fr.texte: Les plugins regroupent des capacités en flux de travail réutilisables dans ChatGPT et Codex. Ils peuvent inclure des skills et des serveurs MCP. Les deux produits utilisent un annuaire universel de plugins ; les mêmes plugins publics sont donc accessibles depuis leurs interfaces prises en charge.
